name: a piano seen flat from above: a dark lid with a sheet of music, a pencil and a record on it, the fallboard, a keyboard of white strips and black keys, the keyslip and the floor; one left hand lies on the keys and a second hand, cut by the frame, pinches its index finger
fits: anything about the hands, fingers, joints, knuckles, stretching, cramps or a habit before typing or playing; the hero is a whole hand with a window on the middle joint of its index finger, the camera dives into the window and back out
recipe: flat 2D top view (no iso), one scale of 55 px a cm: a dark lid rect with a white A4 sheet (staff lines, notes), a pencil and a turning record, a grey fallboard band with a plate, white key strips with seams and black keys that stop two thirds down, a keyslip and a floor band that bleed past the frame; the hand is a palm with a thenar bulge, a thumb of two bones and four fingers of three bones, each a smooth tapered shape with knuckle bumps, creases and a nail; the window shows the two bone ends, cartilage, a blue film of fluid, gas dots and a white cavity
